sentences.text: CRIMINAL MISCELLANEOUS No.66831 of 2024  Arising Out of PS. Case No.-1584 Year-2023 Thana- GOPALGANJ COMPLAINT   District- Gopalganj

======================================================
 Naushad Ali S/o Moharam Ali Resident of Village- Hakam (Paran K tola),
 PS- Mohammadpur, Distt. - Gopalganj  ... ... Pet  Versus  1. The State of Bihar  2. Afsana Khatoon W/o Naushad Ali, D/o Mubarak Hussain R/o vill -  Dhamapakad, P.s. - Manjhagarh, Distt.- Gopalganj  ... ... Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Saurabh Kumar, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Navin Kumar Pandey, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE S. B. PD. SINGH  ORAL ORDER 4 07-04-2025 Heard the parties.
2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 1584 of 2023 for the offence under Sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code and 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. It is a case of matrimonial dispute between the parties.

Petitioner is the husband of opposite party no. 2 (complainant).
4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is quite innocent, committed no offence and has been falsely implicated in this case.

5. During course of argument learned counsel for Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.66831 of 2024(4)
dt.07-04-2025 petitioner submits that earlier this case was referred to Mediation Centre, Patna High Court, Patna where the matter has been amicably settled between the parties and now they are living together and leading their conjugal life happily and there is no grievance now.

7. So keeping in view the aforesaid facts and considering the amicable settlement between the parties, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on anticipatory bail in the event of arrest or surrender within a period of four weeks from the receipt/production of this order, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten thousand) each with two sureties of like amount each to the satisfaction of learned S.D.J.M., Gopalganj in connection with Complaint Case No. 1584 of 2023 subject to the Naushad Ali vs The State Of Bihar on 7 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24182268/
